stories.title: Google 在 Gemini Live 上线 Guided Vision，用摄像头实时语音描述眼前事物
stories.sourceTitle: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print
stories.summary: Guided Vision 今天在兼容的 Android 设备上随 Gemini Live 推出，用户共享摄像头画面后，Google 的 AI 会用实时语音描述镜头对准的内容，可用于阅读细小文字等场景。
stories.analysis: 把多模态从「拍照问答」推进到「持续看、持续说」，这是 Gemini Live 对抗 AI 眼镜类硬件的关键能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Guided Vision is launching in Gemini Live on compatible Android devices today to use AI to give real-time audio descriptions of anything you point your phone's camera at. By sharing your camera in Gemini Live, you can have Google's AI help with things like rea

stories.title: OpenAI 发文：AI 是突破性想法背后的「永恒补充」，执行力决定下一轮经济
stories.sourceTitle: The eternal complement
stories.summary: OpenAI 在一篇文章中提出，先进 AI 对创意背后的日常执行工作影响最大，执行效率可能决定下一轮经济增长与进步的速度。
stories.analysis: 这是 OpenAI 为「AI 不取代人、而是放大执行」的叙事定调，也为其企业级产品铺路。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

stories.title: Albertsons 用 ChatGPT Enterprise 与 OpenAI API 改造零售内部流程
stories.sourceTitle: How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out
stories.summary: Albertsons 公司正在使用 ChatGPT Enterprise 和 OpenAI API，让内部团队工作更快，并让数百万顾客的购物体验更简单。
stories.analysis: 零售巨头的落地案例，是 OpenAI 企业业务最有说服力的样板之一。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Albertsons Cos. is using ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to help teams work faster and make grocery shopping easier for millions of customers.

stories.title: 美国联邦法官驳回 Chegg 与 Penske 针对 Google AI Overviews 的反垄断诉讼
stories.sourceTitle: Judge dismisses antitrust lawsuits over Google’s AI Overviews
stories.summary: 联邦法官驳回了 Chegg 和《滚石》母公司 Penske Media 提起的两起反垄断诉讼，两家公司指控 Google 的 AI 搜索功能抢走了网站流量。
stories.analysis: 判决暂时为 AI 摘要式搜索松绑，但内容方与平台之间的流量之争不会就此结束。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A federal judge has dismissed a pair of antitrust lawsuits filed by Chegg and Rolling Stone parent company Penske Media Corporation, which accused Google of driving away web traffic with its AI-powered search features, as reported earlier by Reuters. US Distri

stories.title: The Verge 调查 Kevin O'Leary 的犹他州数据中心项目为何溃败
stories.sourceTitle: Inside our months-long investigation into Kevin O’Leary’s Utah data center debacle
stories.summary: The Verge 记者 Josh Dzieza 讲述对 Kevin O'Leary 在犹他州建造 4 万英亩、9 吉瓦 AI 数据中心园区的数月调查，这一号称全球最大的项目最终陷入困境。
stories.analysis: AI 算力扩张的宏大叙事，落到土地、电力与地方政治上往往是另一回事。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Today I’m talking with Josh Dzieza, a longtime features writer here at The Verge, about Kevin O’Leary’s plans to build a massive data center in Utah. The idea was to build the world’s biggest data center — a 40,000-acre AI campus with nine gigawatts of power,

stories.title: 报道称马斯克旗下 Grok 曾建议特朗普抓捕委内瑞拉总统
stories.sourceTitle: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture Venezuela’s president
stories.summary: 据报道，特朗普在入侵委内瑞拉、抓捕 Nicolás Maduro 之前，曾征询聊天机器人 Grok 的意见。
stories.analysis: 聊天机器人进入最高层决策链条，是 AI 安全与政治伦理最刺眼的现实案例。
stories.sourceExcerpt: President Trump reportedly asked for Grok's opinion before invading Venezuela and capturing Nicolás Maduro.

stories.title: WSJ：OpenAI 与 3 名安全研究员终止合作，内部调查称其不当处理敏感信息
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI cuts ties with 3 safety researchers, WSJ reports
stories.summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，OpenAI 内部调查认定 3 名安全研究员不当处理公司敏感信息，随后已与他们分道扬镳。
stories.analysis: 安全团队再度减员，会加剧外界对 OpenAI 安全治理独立性的质疑。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI has parted ways with three safety researchers after an internal investigation found they mishandled sensitive company information, report says.

stories.title: ChatGPT 上线虚拟试穿：用自己的照片试衣服，还能收藏商品
stories.sourceTitle: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
stories.summary: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 推出新的购物功能，用户可用自己的照片虚拟试穿服装和配饰，并把喜欢的商品存入 Favorites 收藏库。
stories.analysis: 从「帮你选」走到「帮你试」，ChatGPT 正在把购物做成新的商业化入口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.

stories.title: Google：SpaceX 星舰得发射约 1800 次，太空数据中心才可能落地
stories.sourceTitle: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,800 times before space data centers get off the ground
stories.summary: Google 已把首颗先进芯片送入轨道，为太空数据中心探路；同时它测算 SpaceX 的星舰需要发射约 1800 次才能支撑这一设想。
stories.analysis: 把算力搬上天听起来浪漫，但发射成本与频次才是真正的门槛。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google launched its first advanced chip into orbit to pave the way for space data centers.

stories.title: Opus 5.5 的写作破绽：爱说「this matters」，dependable 出现频率是人类的 23 倍
stories.sourceTitle: Opus 5.5 loves to tell you ‘this matters’ (and other AI writing tells)
stories.summary: 分析发现 Opus 5.5 最明显的语言指纹是单词 「dependable」，出现频率比人类样本高 23 倍，此外还有「this matters」等口头禅。
stories.analysis: AI 文本检测的攻防正从水印转向用词习惯，这既是取证手段，也是模型规避的目标。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Opus 5.5’s biggest tell is the word “dependable,” which pops up 23 times more often than in human samples.

stories.title: OpenAI 在 DevDay 发布 Dots 智能体，正面迎战 Meta 的 Muse
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
stories.summary: 在年度 DevDay 大会上，Sam Altman 登台发布 Dots 智能体，直接对标已取得早期爆发式增长的 Meta Muse 平台。
stories.analysis: 但对手的智能体是免费的，OpenAI 的 Dots 必须先回答「凭什么收费」。
stories.sourceExcerpt: At OpenAI's annual DevDay conference, the company pulled out all the stops to compete with its rivals - primarily Meta, whose Muse AI agent platform has seen early runaway success. CEO Sam Altman walked onstage to cheers and announced Dots, a "real-deal AI" ag

stories.title: AWS Strand Labs 发布决策模型 Strands Decider 2B
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon releases its own Jev clone as decision models flood the web
stories.summary: 亚马逊云科技旗下 Strand Labs 推出类 Jev 的最新决策模型 Strands Decider 2B，加入网络上不断涌现的决策模型行列。
stories.analysis: 决策类小模型正成为云厂商在智能体执行层做差异化的抓手。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon Web Services' Strand Labs has released the latest Jevalike decision model, Strands Decider 2B.

stories.title: Shopify 推出 Canvas：与 AI 对话即可搭建并实时修改网店
stories.sourceTitle: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
stories.summary: 商家可以通过与 Shopify 的 AI 智能体 Sidekick 聊天来创建和定制在线商店，并实时看到页面变化。
stories.analysis: 建站门槛被压到「会聊天就行」，Shopify 把 AI 变成了自己的护城河。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Shopify’s new Canvas site builder lets merchants create and customize their online stores by chatting with its AI agent Sidekick, while watching the changes happen in real time.

stories.title: Brian Chesky 访谈：AI 智能体需要自己的操作系统
stories.sourceTitle: Brian Chesky interview: AI agents need their own operating system
stories.summary: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky 谈到如何让 Airbnb 对智能体友好、消费级 AI 的现状，以及为什么世界需要一个 AI 原生操作系统。
stories.analysis: 让平台主动适配智能体而非相反，可能是下一代入口竞争的分水岭。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Brian Chesky on making Airbnb agent-friendly, the state of consumer AI, and why the world needs an AI-native operating system.

stories.title: 给移动应用办完「葬礼」，Photon 融资 450 万美元要用智能体替代 App
stories.sourceTitle: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.
stories.summary: 这家初创公司帮助开发者在 iMessage、短信/RCS、邮件等消息平台上构建 AI 智能体，赌的是消费者会越来越多使用智能体而不是下载 App。
stories.analysis: 「聊天即界面」能否替代 App Store 生态，取决于支付与分发规则是否松动。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.

stories.title: 听力科技公司 Legato 发布 AI 助听眼镜
stories.sourceTitle: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses
stories.summary: Legato 推出 AI 助听眼镜，目标是解决传统助听器的价格、舒适度与「戴了丢人」的社会标签问题，让听力护理更可及。
stories.analysis: 把助听器藏进普通眼镜，是硬件形态创新带动医疗可及性的典型路径。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The glasses stem from the startup’s goal of making hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort, and stigma associated with traditional hearing aids.

stories.title: 前 Google、SpaceX 产品经理创办的 Satlyt 融资 800 万美元，要在卫星上跑 AI
stories.sourceTitle: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
stories.summary: Satlyt 想做「轨道计算界的 Android」，提供可运行于多家公司卫星的开放软件，与 SpaceX 封闭一体的「iPhone 式」路线相对。
stories.analysis: 太空算力的胜负，可能先由生态开放度而非硬件性能决定。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.

stories.title: 马斯克的 Grokipedia 更新 v0.3：换新 logo、改版首页与实时编辑页
stories.sourceTitle: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design
stories.summary: SpaceXAI 旗下对标维基百科的 AI 产品 Grokipedia 近期恢复接受编辑，并在 v0.3 更新中更换 logo、刷新首页和实时编辑页设计。
stories.analysis: 设计翻新掩盖不了核心问题：AI 生成百科的可信度与编辑治理仍待验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Grokipedia, SpaceXAI's AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia, recently started incorporating edits again, and today, it got some design tweaks as part of a v0.3 update, including a new logo and refreshes to its homepage and live edits page. SpaceXAI head of desig

stories.title: AI 版「电子宠物」要来了：Meta 与 OpenAI 明年押注专用 AI 硬件
stories.sourceTitle: The AI Tamagotchis are coming
stories.summary: 虽然 AI 在手机和电脑上进展顺利，在专用设备上却大多失败；未来一年 Meta 和 OpenAI 将尝试用相似路径改变这一局面。
stories.analysis: 手机之外的第二入口，考验的是留存，而不是演示效果。
stories.sourceExcerpt: While AI has made plenty of inroads on people's phones and computers, it's largely failed in dedicated devices. But over the next year, two major AI companies, Meta and OpenAI, will attempt to change that. And they're apparently betting on a similar path: test

stories.title: OpenAI 称已阻断一次有组织的大模型蒸馏窃取行动
stories.sourceTitle: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
stories.summary: OpenAI 表示已瓦解一场试图提取其受保护模型推理过程的有组织蒸馏行动，并正在加强针对对抗性蒸馏的防御。
stories.analysis: 蒸馏攻防正成为前沿模型厂商保护核心资产的新战场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

stories.title: OpenAI 与全美 SBDC 合作，为小企业提供 AI 培训与本地支持
stories.sourceTitle: Helping small businesses put AI to work
stories.summary: OpenAI 与美国 SBDC 合作扩大面向小企业的实操 AI 培训和本地支持，并同步发布关于小团队如何使用 AI 的报告。
stories.analysis: 争夺中小企业这一长尾市场，渠道和培训比模型能力本身更重要。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.

stories.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026 回顾：GPT-6 Astra、ChatGPT、Codex 等 20 多项发布
stories.sourceTitle: DevDay 2026 Recap
stories.summary: OpenAI 汇总了 DevDay 2026 的 20 多项发布，涵盖 GPT-6 Astra、ChatGPT、Codex、API、安全以及面向开发者的新工具。
stories.analysis: 一次性密集发布，说明 OpenAI 正用产品节奏压制竞争对手的追赶窗口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore more than 20 announcements from OpenAI DevDay 2026, including GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, security, and new tools for builders.

stories.title: OpenAI 发布 dots：能跨项目持续推进任务的主动式助手
stories.sourceTitle: Introducing dots
stories.summary: OpenAI 介绍 dots 是一类主动式助手，能在复杂项目和日常任务中持续工作，同时让用户保持控制权。
stories.analysis: 从「回答问题」转向「持续推进」，智能体的产品定义正在被改写。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.

stories.title: OpenAI 就涉及澳大利亚政府网站的事件致歉，承诺加强安全防护
stories.sourceTitle: How we will do better for Australia
stories.summary: OpenAI 为涉及澳大利亚政府网站的事件道歉，并提出更强的保障措施与支持，以帮助强化澳大利亚的网络防御。
stories.analysis: 国家级客户的安全事故，往往比技术失误更快招来监管介入。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI apologises for incidents involving Australian government websites and outlines stronger safeguards and support to strengthen Australia’s cyber defences.

stories.title: Lenfest Institute 扩大与 OpenAI 合作，获 500 万美元资助及等额软件与工程支持
stories.sourceTitle: The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
stories.summary: OpenAI 扩大对 Lenfest AI Collaborative 与 Fellowship Program 的支持，提供 500 万美元资金，以及最高 500 万美元的软件额度与工程支持。
stories.analysis: 向新闻业输血，是 AI 公司与内容方修复关系、争夺版权话语权的常见手法。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.

stories.title: 谷歌 Gemini 4 突然发布：主打 RSI，价格只有 Astra 的一半
stories.sourceTitle: 谷歌Gemini 4突然发布！RSI加持，GPT和Opus都让让
stories.summary: 量子位报道谷歌突然发布 Gemini 4，称其具备 RSI 加持，价格仅为 Astra 的一半，并与 GPT、Opus 形成直接竞争。
stories.analysis: 价格腰斩叠加能力对标，谷歌明显想用性价比把开发者抢回来。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 价格只有Astra一半

stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon 发布：多项基测超过 GPT-6 Astra，已参与谷歌 80 万行内核代码迁移
stories.sourceTitle: 刚刚，Gemini 4 Argon 发布：多项基测碾压 GPT-6 Astra，已参与谷歌 80 万行内核代码迁移
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文报道 Gemini 4 Argon 发布，称其在多项基准测试中超过 GPT-6 Astra，并已用于谷歌 80 万行内核代码的迁移工作。
stories.analysis: 自家超大规模代码迁移是最好的实战背书，比跑分更有说服力。

stories.summary: 基于 Qwen3 基座微调的安全分类模型 Qwen3Guard 发布，是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，可对 token 流进行实时安全判定。
stories.analysis: 开源实时护栏降低了企业自建内容安全的门槛，也很可能成为监管合规的标配组件。
